title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Ulcerative Colitis
description: Zingiber officinale essential oils have been traditionally used to treat ulcerative colitis, a chronic inflammatory bowel disease, due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale, including gingerols and shogaols, have been shown to help reduce inflammation and oxidative stress in the gut, thus alleviating symptoms of ulcerative colitis.
